welcome.subheadline: Learn music from scratch, a few minutes a day, with an always-there practice advisor.
welcome.benefit1Desc: Short, structured lessons starting from finding your very first note.
welcome.benefit2Desc: Tailored daily plan that adapts to your pace—even 5 minutes a day.
welcome.benefit3Desc: Instant troubleshooting for common posture, hand, and note-finding questions.

profile.title: Profile & Settings
profile.aboutBody: MUSICHER is a calm, step-by-step music education platform designed to help absolute beginners build daily musical habits a few minutes at a time.
profile.aboutNote: Prototype edition · All data is stored locally in your browser.
profile.resetBody: This will clear all completed lessons, your streak, and your preferences, and return to the welcome screen.

diagrams.fingerNumbersAria: Right hand finger numbers 1 to 5 aligned over white keys C D E F G

piano.title: Practice Piano
piano.freePlaySub: Explore the 2-octave keyboard (C3 to C5) with touch, mouse, or computer keys.
piano.watchPlaying: Listen and watch the highlighted keys...
piano.watchHint: Tap "Play demo" to see and hear the notes at {tempo} BPM.
piano.ownInstruction: Play this sequence in order without key glow ({current}/{total}):
piano.ownFailHint: Not quite that sequence — let's try again from the first note!
piano.computerKeysHint: Desktop keys (C4–C5): A W S E D F T G Y H U J K
piano.handBoth: Left hand for C3, right hand for C4 and C5

courses.comingSoonSub: This course path is outlined in our curriculum and lessons are on the way. Switch back to Piano & Keyboard to continue practicing today.

practice.rhythmInstruction: Listen to the demo or tap the drum pad (or press Space) in time with each beat. Stay silent on rests!
practice.rhythmSpaceHint: Desktop tip: Press Spacebar to tap
practice.earPromptHigherLower: Listen to the two notes. Is the second note higher or lower?
practice.earPromptSameDifferent: Listen carefully. Are the two patterns the same or different?
practice.earPromptStepSkip: Do these notes move by a neighbor step or a skip?
practice.earPromptMajorMinor: Listen to this chord. Does it sound Major (bright) or Minor (warm)?
practice.earPromptInterval: Listen to the distance between these two notes. Which interval do you hear?
practice.earRightMsg: Spot on! Your ear caught it.
practice.earWrongMsg: Not quite — tap "Play again" and compare the sounds.
practice.singInstruction: 1. Tap "Listen to notes" to hear the reference pitch. 2. Sing it back softly on "La" or solfege (no mic needed). 3. Tap confirm when done.
practice.fretboardFollowHint: Tap the glowing teal position on the neck: String {string}, Fret {fret}
practice.fretboardWrongHint: Look for the glowing teal circle on String {string}
practice.chordFollowInstruction: Tap the strum buttons in order ({current}/{total}): next is {dir}
practice.santurFollowHint: Tap the glowing teal bridge (kharak) to strike {note}
practice.santurWrongHint: Look for the glowing teal bridge for {note}
